answer: In a wildfire-sensing agent market, reports of an ember on a ledge or smoke over yarrow earn one operator bonus per epoch. A uniqueness issuer checks each human operator in person and gives a blind-signed credential. Each claim proves credential possession and reveals a deterministic epoch nullifier; duplicate nullifiers are rejected across all agent keys. Extra aliases cannot claim again. An attacker must recruit another verified person per extra bonus, paying recruitment and coordination costs.
